note: Routing corpus of record (minted 2026-07-17). Positives span the seven axes: issue/PR/discussion distinction, Issue Types/Fields vs. labels, sub-issues vs. task lists, closing keywords, PR lifecycle/review, Projects v2, and the bug/task/feature synthesis. Negatives drawn adversarially from: git-campaign-workflows (this workspace's OWN git worktree/merge mechanics, same plugin, easily confused since both are git/GitHub-flavored), doc-writing-rules (the TICKET/ADR document contract itself), the three docs capture skills (actually filing/resuming a work item, execution not platform-fact lookup), ADR-0002/ADR-0003 (the ruling itself, not the platform facts behind it), ops-repo/ops-issues (execution agents, not this answers-only pack), and two authoring-standards siblings plus spec-linear-adapter (a different platform's concrete adapter contract, not generic GitHub knowledge).
